description: Search everything on Bettrails by name: eSoccer (virtual football) players with their league, matches and ELO; eSoccer head-to-head pages ("lost vs troy"); NBA 2K virtual basketball players and head-to-heads; esports teams and players (League of Legends, Dota 2, CS2, VALORANT), champions, heroes, agents, maps, tournaments and countries. Returns the matching pages (readable with read_page). Useful when the exact name, league or game is not known (the same nickname can exist in several leagues).

language.description: Language of the bettrails.com links returned (normally the language of the conversation). Default: es.

league.description: Optional league filter. gt = GTLeagues; adriatic = Adriatic League; valhalla = Valhalla League; valkyrie = Valkyrie League; ggleague = GG League; esportsbattle = EsportsBattle; erivals = eRivals; cyberlivearena = Cyber Live Arena; volta = EsportsBattle Volta.

query.description: Name or part of the name, e.g. "snak", "caps", "vitality", "lost vs troy", "jarvan".

name: search
title: Search Bettrails
